Farmers' income boost from bamboo and bean cultivation

Farmers in Siwan are set to increase their income through bamboo cultivation, with subsidies of up to ₹36,000 per hectare available. In Bastar, farmers cultivating beans on one acre, with costs between ₹60,000-₹70,000, are expecting profits in the lakhs.
